apparel.title: Ivory Tweed Jacket, Pearl Trim
apparel.lead: A tailored western jacket cut from handwoven ivory silk-cotton tweed, finished with pearl button detailing and gold chain trim along the edges.

apparel.title: Amber Check Tailored Blazer
apparel.lead: A single-breasted blazer in a multicolour amber and burgundy check, woven from a silk-wool tweed blend for structure and warmth.

apparel.title: Olive Tweed Mini Dress
apparel.lead: A shawl-collar mini dress in an olive and gold multicolour tweed, finished with brass buttons and fringed pocket trim.

apparel.title: Indigo Ombre Halter Dress
apparel.lead: A halter-neck midi dress in an indigo-to-teal ombre weave, with a draped waist tie and front slit, woven on traditional Banarasi looms.
